guidelines.title: Superlatives & Unsubstantiated Claims
guidelines.description: Absolute superlatives such as "#1", "number one", "guaranteed", "risk-free", or "best-in-class" are strictly prohibited unless linked to an active, validated Approved Source. When unverified, substitute with measured qualifiers such as "leading" or "designed to".

guidelines.title: Numeric and Performance Data Verification
guidelines.description: Every numeric percentage, technical specification, and dollar amount quoted in content must be documented verbatim in an active Approved Source. Unverified figures create regulatory advertising liability.

compliant: Saves up to 23% based on 2024 independent testing

guidelines.title: Approved Terminology & Prohibited Expressions
guidelines.description: Refer to our brand as Northwind Home, never abbreviated as Northwind or NW Home. Use smart climate control instead of HVAC gadgetry.

guidelines.title: Brand Capitalization & Orthography
guidelines.description: Ensure strict capitalization for trademarked product terms such as EcoMode and Northwind Bridge. Never use separated or lowercase spellings.

guidelines.title: Visual Accessibility and Alternative Descriptions
guidelines.description: All imagery must include descriptive, purposeful alt text for assistive screen readers. Ensure all foreground text against background colors satisfies minimum WCAG AA contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.

compliant: ![Northwind Home thermostat mounted on oak wall](...)]

guidelines.title: Structural Accessibility and Meaningful Links
guidelines.description: Maintain hierarchical heading order without skipping levels (e.g. h1 followed directly by h3). Links must provide descriptive context; never use ambiguous phrases like "click here" or "read more".

guidelines.title: Editorial Tone & Professional Punctuation
guidelines.description: Maintain a calm, measured, architectural tone. Consecutive exclamation marks, excessive caps, and sensationalist phrasing are prohibited.

violation: Incredible performance you must see right now!!!

guidelines.title: Brand Voice, Formality & Vocabulary
guidelines.description: Avoid informal internet slang, colloquial hype, or overly casual idioms. Northwind speaks with technical authority and domestic elegance.

guidelines.title: Logo Clearspace & Protection Zone
guidelines.description: The Northwind Home emblem requires a minimum exclusion zone equal to half the emblem height. Never rotate, recolor, or distort the logo.

guidelines.title: Information Security & Credential Protection
guidelines.description: Zero tolerance for production credentials, secret keys (sk_live_, AKIA, ghp_), internal codenames, or employee personal data in external collateral.

compliant: Configure via Northwind Cloud Console credentials.
